items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the public C20H17ClN6OS neutral singlet thione connectivity and preserves the source-label mapping for the requested geometry selectors.
items.expected: Identity, charge, multiplicity, tautomer and mapping are explicitly verified.

items.statement: At least two independently selected models are converged and validated as stationary structures before comparison.
items.expected: The report provides model rationale, convergence and stationarity evidence and discloses failures.

items.statement: The report quantitatively compares the requested bond lengths, angles and torsions to the SCXRD reference.
items.expected: Per-row observables and per-model MAE/RMSE are supplied with units and circular torsion handling.

items.statement: The interpretation is limited to isolated-molecule geometry versus crystal molecular geometry.
items.expected: The conclusion does not infer packing energetics, biological activity or mechanism from this comparison.
